name: S3g_burn_retired
description: burn_retired on 05: on a live series it is TerminalStatus; once S1 is Retired (05 #39) and b1 and b2 have claimed (05 #45-#46), a wallet that never held units gets a zero burn with no registration check, a holder's units burn while its pending payout stays claimable (05 #49), a repeat and a holder whose claim already burned its units are zero burns. On the Retired series claim_tail is NotRedeemed and claim_final TerminalStatus. 05 then runs to its end. 05 #42 (expect_revert retire_if_capped, BLK-1) is left out: no canonical command until S5, and the scenario does not need it.

steps.note: never held units: a zero burn, no registration check
05 #47: b3's 100 units burn, its pending payout stays
its claim at 05 #45 burned its units: a zero burn
